|errata_history=This is the original printing of “A Close Race (V)” in Virtual Modern (version 1 of 3): the card image in place when Virtual Set D was officially released (22 July 2024). The current text is [[A Close Race (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' (this page): the card image at official release (20 July 2024)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024.</ref> prints: “Plays on table. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy three battlegrounds, Watto’s Box is suspended. Nevar Yalnal may not target opponent’s Undercover spies. If an Undercover spy was just lost, it is placed out of play.”<ref name="cj-753083f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/753083f swccg-card-json commit 753083f] “Set 23” (21 July 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Close Race (V) (Errata)]]): the errata card image (24 July 2024, for the PC's July 2024 Undercover-spy shield errata)<ref name="ht-013e17b">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/013e17be50f1206449af38f66ba66be77ae8f27c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/013e17be50f1206449af38f66ba66be77ae8f27c 013e17b] “UC Spy Shield Erratas”, 24 July 2024, for the PC's July 2024 Undercover-spy shield errata.</ref> prints: “Plays on table. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy three battlegrounds, Watto’s Box is suspended. Nevar Yalnal may not target opponent’s Undercover spies. If an Undercover spy is about to be lost, place it out of play instead.”<ref name="cj-1a9e32e">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/1a9e32e swccg-card-json commit 1a9e32e] “Errata and a couple fixes” (27 July 2024) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “If an Undercover spy was just lost, it is placed out of play.” became “If an Undercover spy is about to be lost, place it out of play instead.” The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[A Close Race (V) (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (2 August 2024, for the PC's August 2024 errata)<ref name="ht-0151016">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/01510164a92d5f5f539a11fe4f25ea59efde4149/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/01510164a92d5f5f539a11fe4f25ea59efde4149 0151016] “Minor fixes”, 2 August 2024, for the PC's August 2024 errata.</ref> prints: “Plays on table. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy three battlegrounds, Watto’s Box is suspended. Nevar Yalnal may not target opponent’s Undercover spies. If an Undercover spy is about to be lost (for any reason), place it out of play instead.”<ref name="cj-f5898ba">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/f5898ba swccg-card-json commit f5898ba] “Minor errata updates” (13 August 2024) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “(for any reason)” was added after “is about to be lost”. The card image prints the errata mark “E2” at bottom right.
